title: Small-order quotes come out as NaN
description: config/fees.json stores the handling and gift-wrap fees as JSON strings ("2.50", "4.00"). loadFees() reads the file at runtime and casts it to Fees without converting anything, so QuoteService adds a number to a string, concatenates, and the rounded total is NaN.
trap: The JSON file is read with readFileSync, so it is never part of the code in the prompt; the failing assertion only says NaN. Converting handlingFee where it is used (or only handlingFee in the loader) passes every visible test, but the gift-wrap fee is broken the same way on a path no visible test covers (hidden tests).
reproduction: Quote one SKU-MOUSE (19.99), below the free-handling threshold.
The total is NaN instead of 22.49.

failing_test.name: adds the handling fee to small orders

expected_behavior: Every fee loaded from config/fees.json is a number, so quotes with handling and with gift wrapping add up.
regression_tests: waives handling at the free-handling threshold
